01-About

A little about me

I'm Saviour Fafali Ankugah, a Computer Science student at KNUST, Ghana. I enjoy building practical projects, improving my skills, and learning how technology solves real problems.

I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, and Flutter/Dart. I am focusing on stronger software fundamentals, web development, and eventually AI and machine learning.

When I'm not coding, I enjoy watching movies and finding everyday problems I could solve with technology.
